dimensions.assessment: Affects the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library Foundation, the Department of the Interior, and the general public visiting the library.
dimensions.evidence: preserve and make available to the public materials relating to the life of President Theodore Roosevelt

dimensions.assessment: Provides up to $50 million in federal grants and artifact loans for the establishment of a presidential library.
dimensions.evidence: grants in an amount not to exceed a total of $50,000,000 for the establishment of the Library

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal grants up to $50,000,000, subject to appropriations and a $100,000,000 non-federal matching requirement.
dimensions.evidence: grants in an amount not to exceed a total of $50,000,000

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific grants and museum artifact loans for a single presidential library project.
dimensions.evidence: contribute funds and artifacts to the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora, North Dakota.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent establishment of a library and artifact loan agreements, with one-time grant funding.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary may enter into 1 or more agreements

missing_information: Exact timeline for grant disbursements and artifact loans is not fully specified beyond a 180-day window for loan agreements.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides up to $50,000,000 in federal grants and artifact loans for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library in Medora, North Dakota, conditioned on $100,000,000 in non-federal matching funds.
